patterns: Direct place/date items dominate: Mangal Pandey at Barrackpore, revolt began at Meerut, Enfield rifle introduced Dec 1856 (immediate cause, APPSC 2019).
Not-a-cause trap: officers' inefficiency was NOT a cause (BPSC 2018); APPSC 2023 accepted Subedar ceiling + greased cartridges.
Historiography asked as book-author matches (Savarkar, S.B. Chaudhuri, Ashok Mehta, Syed Ahmed Khan first in Indian language).
Awadh/Oudh as source of most rebel soldiers recurs.
App has many multi-statement items and general national-movement book matches filed here; PYQs are mostly one-line recall.
